note: Models of the 32B pair. Weights are not redistributed; obtain them from the Hugging Face Hub at these revisions. The helper's 27 repository files were verified at this revision (helper_download_verified.json).
runtime: HF transformers only; bfloat16, SDPA, greedy, batch size 1, TF32 off, seed 0; helper background at most 256 new tokens, answers at most 64; explicit layer sharding (no tensor parallelism, no quantization, no offload)
device_map: helper embedding and layers 0-31 on GPU 0, layers 32-63, final norm and LM head on GPU 1; receiver the same on GPUs 2 and 3
hardware: one exclusive node with 4x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB per job
